0.0: Okay, enough dillydallying. We've got work to do! This time, I need #b20 #t4032960#s#k. \r\n#L0##bWhat is a...#o3230100#? I've never heard of such a thing!#l\n#k

1.2: So, your hypothesis is that some #o2230100#s left their caves and eventually became #o3230100#s? Fascinating! Yes, my evidence does indicate that. This is worth some more research...

yes.0: Oh, while you were out, I found another item that belong to my old archer friend. I'd like you to have it.
